frase_gancho.texto: Why the heart of the city burned, and how it became legend.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: To bid farewell to your visit as you walk toward the exit or rest in the shade, two final chapters bring all the pieces together. The first reconstructs the fall of Teotihuacán in the middle of the sixth century: how drought, a commercial crisis and discontent ended in a selective fire that devastated the palaces of power but spared the homes of the common people. The second travels through time, from the pilgrimages of the Mexica among the ruins to the archaeologists who, with tunnels and robots, continue to reveal its secrets.
